messages.content: "Can you help me plan my day? I want to start from my home in New York and go to a chess club named 'Knight Gambit' located in Boston. I want to take the fastest route. After that, I want to go to another chess club named 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia, again taking the fastest route. Finally, I want to return home, but this time I want to take the shortest route. Can you also provide me with the details of the events hosted by both chess clubs?"

function.name: chess_club_details_find
function.description: Provides details about a chess club, including location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the chess club.

city.description: The city in which the chess club is located.

event.description: The event hosted by the club.

function.name: route_planner_calculate_route
function.description: Determines the best route between two points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start.description: The starting point of the journey.

method.description: The method to use when calculating the route (default is 'fastest').

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1) Start at home in New York.

2) Go to Knight Gambit in Boston via fastest route.

3) Then go to Rook Corner in Philadelphia via fastest route.

4) Return home via shortest route.

Also request details of events hosted by both chess clubs.

We need to call route planner twice: first NY->Boston fast; second Boston->Philadelphia fast; third Philly->NY short.

And we need to get chess club details for each club: Knight Gambit in Boston, Rook Corner in Philadelphia.

Thus we will make calls to route_planner_calculate_route three times, and chess_club_details_find twice.

But note that the tool expects JSON input. We should produce separate calls or combine them?

In previous examples, they used multiple calls sequentially. We'll do it stepwise.

First call route_planner_calculate_route(start="New York", destination="Boston", method="fastest").

Second call route_planner_calculate_route(start="Boston", destination="Philadelphia", method="fastest").

Third call route_planner_calculate_route(start="Philadelphia", destination="New York", method="shortest").

Then call chess_club_details_find(name="Knight Gambit", city="Boston") maybe include event param if needed.

Similarly for Rook Corner in Philadelphia.

We'll output results after calling all functions.

Let's proceed.
